CVE-2023-45288.description: An attacker may cause an HTTP/2 endpoint to read arbitrary amounts of header data by sending an excessive number of CONTINUATION frames. The fix sets a limit on the amount of excess header frames we will process before closing a connection.

CVE-2024-53263.description: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. CVE-2025-26625.description: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. In Git LFS versions 0.5.2 through 3.7.0, when populating a Git repository's working tree with the contents of Git LFS objects, certain Git LFS commands may write to files visible outside the current Git working tree if symbolic or hard links exist which collide with the paths of files tracked by Git LFS. However, any symbolic or hard links in existing repositories will still provide the opportunity for Git LFS to write to their targets.

CVE-2025-26625.description: Git LFS is a Git extension for versioning large files. In Git LFS versions 0.5.2 through 3.7.0, when populating a Git repository's working tree with the contents of Git LFS objects, certain Git LFS commands may write to files visible outside the current Git working tree if symbolic or hard links exist which collide with the paths of files tracked by Git LFS. However, any symbolic or hard links in existing repositories will still provide the opportunity for Git LFS to write to their targets.
